findings.title: Flex layout disables the small-action button's right float
findings.body: Making `.small-action` a flex container causes its direct `button` child to become a flex item, so the existing `float: right` on that button no longer positions it at the far right. When the description does not fill the row, the button will sit immediately after the description instead of remaining right-aligned, changing the small-action layout.
